subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these six pinned third-party GitHub Action upgrades after the current-head workflow results and upstream release revisions are reviewed?
rationale: The patch changes code executed with repository security and publishing privileges, and the protected `security` label reserves that trust-boundary decision for a maintainer.

options.title: Review and approve the action upgrades
options.body: Confirm the upstream release revisions and refreshed workflow results, then merge the focused SHA-pinned update.

options.title: Hold the current versions
options.body: Keep the existing action pins if the upstream behavior or release changes are not acceptable for the repository’s security and publishing workflows.

recommendation.title: Review and approve the action upgrades
recommendation.body: Confirm the upstream release revisions and refreshed workflow results, then merge the focused SHA-pinned update.
